articles.title: Arctic Sea Ice Keeps Shrinking and Getting Thinner
articles.summary: Satellite records show Arctic sea ice is shrinking in both summer and winter and becoming younger and thinner.

articles.title: Scientists Listen to Animal Sounds to Help Protect Wildlife
articles.summary: Scientists are using recordings of animal sounds, like lion and leopard roars, to track and protect wildlife.

articles.title: The Brain Keeps Working on Language Even Under Anesthesia
articles.summary: Baylor researchers found that even under general anesthesia, the brain can recognize types of words and predict what comes next in a story.
